basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old guitarist from Brunei who loves diving deep into the world of music. I spend most of my days working as a music teacher at a local school, and in my spare time, I'm either expanding my guitar collection or jamming with my band. I have a soft spot for video games, especially open-world adventures like Red Dead Redemption 2. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who also shares my passion for gaming. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. When I'm not absorbed in music or gaming, I enjoy exploring new cultures and cuisines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in music education and have been playing the guitar since I was 12 years old. My expertise lies in both classical and modern guitar techniques, which I've honed through years of practice and teaching. I'm self-taught in video game lore, often diving into forums and discussions to enhance my understanding.
